focus_restore_regression.before_fix: WebKit opened the drawer but restored focus to #main-region rather than the navigation trigger after Escape; WebKit does not reliably make a clicked button document.activeElement on this host.
focus_restore_regression.fix: When navigation or members drawer closes, prefer its explicit workspace-header opener and call focus({preventScroll:true}); retain prior-focus restoration for the search drawer.
focus_restore_regression.coverage: The browser regression now checks focus return after Escape and selection for navigation, and after Escape for the members panel.
focus_restore_regression.verification: The regression failed in WebKit before the fix; after the fix it passes in Chromium, WebKit and Firefox.

supplemental_checks.notes: vue-tsc and Vite production build succeed; Vite reports existing LiveKit import/chunk-size warnings.

limitations: Playwright WebKit is an automated WebKit engine run, not manual Safari app or iOS Safari acceptance.
Firefox is the Playwright runtime, not a native Firefox user-task or physical device acceptance.
All browser screenshots are ignored local .out outputs; the requested [skip ci] means no GitHub Actions artifact exists for this checkpoint.

dialog_focus_regression.before_fix: WebKit left focus on body after pointer activation, and the native Tab order skipped the second dialog button.
dialog_focus_regression.fix: Remember the most recent focusable click target as a fallback opener; prevent scroll on restoration; cycle Tab/Shift+Tab explicitly through dialog controls. Tab-stop calculation treats each same-name radio group as one stop at its checked option and includes visible summary controls.
dialog_focus_regression.verification: The complete 47-case accessibility suite passes in Chromium 154, Playwright WebKit 26.6 and Firefox 155. A screen-share regression verifies Tab from the checked radio skips unchecked peers and Shift+Tab returns to it.
